description: Nuwarapassa Padiduralage Gunendra and Another v. Alliance Finance Company Limited Nuwarapassa Padiduralage Gunendra and Another v. Alliance Finance Company Limited View More before Hon. Upaly Abeyrathne, J.
parties: Nuwarapassa Padiduralage Gunendra and Another v. Alliance Finance Company Limited Nuwarapassa Padiduralage Gunendra and Another v. Alliance Finance Company Limited View More
keywords: The Appellants challenged the District Court judgement holding them liable for sums due under a hire purchase agreement, contending that the vehicle had been robbed by terrorists and was inadequately insured against robbery. Held - alleged robbery had not been proved as no police complaint or other supporting documentation was produced; therefore, issue of insurance did not arise. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
